decisionLogic: Treat a geological-map polygon as mapped geology beneath topsoil at map scale.
Treat a borehole as an observed vertical sequence at one point.
Require an independently reviewed vocabulary binding before selecting any borehole interval.
Never infer thickness, contact geometry, or lateral continuation from semantic compatibility.
exclusions: No assumption that the zero-depth borehole interval must equal the mapped unit
validationMethod: Positive, missing-binding, pending-review, and wrong-source tests
reopenCondition: A map product with a different representation-depth definition is introduced
